_comment: prj12 twin-board burn config (B1 candidate). ASCII only on purpose (PS 5.1 + GBK console safety).
_pc_nic_note: pc_nic must equal Get-NetAdapter Name column exactly (localized names possible; run -Step 1 -DryRun to list candidates).
_eth_port_note: Data plane uses board GE2 (not GE1): ETH pins in XDC match official KU_IO.xdc #GE2 block (AC31/Y33/W33/W34/V33/AC32/Y32/AE32/Y31/AF32/AF30/AG30/AA33). 2026-11-06 measured.
_p1_elf_note: P1 A->B needs BitElf + serial d (DMA write mode). Bit-only burn: pfwd_wr rises but mem_wr_frm/pk_frames stay 0.
_b1_note: B1 = P1 baseline RTL + reset pairing patch (frame_mem_if 5 async FIFO ui-side reset). Bit+ltx must stay paired; default scripts/probes.ltx belongs to baseline C856BA83 - DO NOT use it with this bitstream.
_host_note: 2026-11-12 PC1 实测：CH340=COM7，数据网卡=以太网/1Gbps；board B 由 PC2 填。
